text: Create and submit an exceptional SPC application for Aimparency
description: Prepare a genuinely strong South Park Commons application that is deep, credible, specific, and intellectually intriguing. This idea has two inseparable purposes: (1) make a serious attempt to secure funding, community, and support for Aimparency; and (2) serve as a worked demonstration that a durable, inspectable idea graph can preserve human direction across long-running autonomous work by replaceable AI executors (Codex is the current executor, not the source of intent). The final application must stand on ordinary selection merits and must not rely on the recursive process as a gimmick. Capture program-specific requirements, founder truth, product thesis, technical substance, real-world evidence, skeptical review, drafts, and submission confirmation. Treat claims as hypotheses until supported.

status.comment: Felix 2026-10-16: not submitted; the 3 Aug deadline passed. Drafts stay in meta/applications/spc-founder-fellowship-2026/.

valueRationale: A successful application could provide funding, community, credibility, and high-leverage feedback; even without acceptance, a rigorous application and inspectable execution record can clarify the thesis and demonstrate the product on a consequential real task.
